name: Saori
source:
A weird girl from the parallel class.

[spoiler]Is actually an alien. Was sent to Earth to destroy it. Starts off as cold and emotionless, but soon warms up to Noboru. Regardless of the ending, Saori always kills Sara.[/spoiler]
